content.label: Consolidated Edison (via ABC Consulting)
content: Architected and delivered a governed analytics assistant leveraging Gemini, BigQuery, and tool-calling architectures, embedding analyst rules, operational controls, and auditable execution for AI-enabled construction and financial analytics.

Developed automated frameworks for profiling, type inference, duplicate detection, candidate key analysis, and cross-system join validation across 100+ source tables and millions of operational and financial records, enhancing data quality and interoperability.
Defined a phased analytical maturity roadmap for anomaly detection, construction analytics, and AI-enabled decision support, guiding strategic adoption of advanced analytics capabilities.

content.label: NBCUniversal (via Apex Systems)
content: Architected AWS-based AI and graph analytics pipelines leveraging SageMaker, Terraform, S3, and containerized workloads to enable scalable, cloud-native analytics solutions.

Evaluated and demonstrated emerging graph analytics and graph machine learning technologies—including Neptune, GraphStorm, Bedrock, and LangGraph—to support dependency analysis and operational intelligence initiatives.

Mentored engineers and technical professionals on AI architecture, governance, implementation tradeoffs, and enterprise adoption strategies, fostering cross-functional enablement and technical leadership.

Delivered advanced instruction on transformer architectures, LLMs, RAG, agentic and multimodal AI, diffusion models, and enterprise AI governance, enabling practical understanding of generative and agentic AI development workflows.

Led multi-month AI and machine learning training programs for software engineers and data scientists through university- and enterprise-sponsored continuing education initiatives, driving continuous learning and talent development.

Consolidated fragmented reporting into unified Tableau dashboards and automated executive reporting workflows using Python and SQL, significantly reducing report preparation time and driving operational efficiency.
Collaborated with finance, marketing, and product stakeholders to translate attribution and performance data into actionable business recommendations, strengthening cross-functional alignment.

Designed and developed the ReMon framework, empowering engineering teams to implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems without deep internal tooling expertise; adopted across Meta FinTech and enabled automatic detection of over 15 SEVs in 2024.

Built forecasting and performance-management frameworks that translated engineering initiatives into projected reliability outcomes, directly informing planning, goal setting, and leadership decision-making across business pillars.

Delivered impact sizing, ROI, and risk exposure analyses to guide investment and prioritization decisions for platform reliability, privacy compliance, authentication, testing infrastructure, and data platform initiatives.

Built attribution frameworks linking incidents, alerts, defects, and operational metrics to engineering organizations and service ownership structures, enabling more accurate accountability and performance measurement.

Developed and deployed gradient-boosting propensity models to optimize digital marketing campaigns, driving a 146% increase in conversions and a 229% rise in campaign-attributed revenue while automating audience segmentation and targeting workflows for improved efficiency and scalability.

Directed data science initiatives leveraging a 30B+ transaction dataset to develop analytical products and market intelligence capabilities through large-scale feature engineering, merchant intelligence, and consumer-spending analytics.

Architected a scalable SEO and information-architecture framework for Nike's product discovery, aligning customer navigation with search engine indexation to support a rapidly growing product catalog.

Conceived, architected, and led adoption of RITHM, a real-time operational intelligence platform aggregating monitoring signals by business capability and system ownership, reducing major incident detection times from hours to minutes.

Secured executive sponsorship and partnered with CTO-level leadership to define enterprise monitoring strategy, expanding Splunk-based prototypes into a scalable Kafka and Elastic Stack solution aligned with open-source modernization initiatives.

Developed predictive capacity-management models for customer-facing banking platforms, enabling infrastructure planning and risk management through demand forecasting based on business-process and temporal drivers.

content.role: Senior Principal Systems Engineer / Program Manager
content: Led systems engineering organizations of 40-50 engineers specializing in modeling, simulation, analysis, and advanced aerospace systems, providing technical leadership, career development, and proposal support for programs valued up to $50M.

Turned around an over-budget classified fixed-price technology program by establishing execution plans, aligning engineering teams, and proactively managing technical and program risks; delivered under budget and nearly doubled the original profit target on a historically challenging delivery effort.
Built a GraphRAG system for multi-hop benefits reasoning with fully traceable retrieval paths across entities, clauses, and supporting evidence.
Fine-tuned a LoRA adapter on a 7B open-source LLM to enforce a strict JSON schema (decision/reason/disclaimer) for reliable downstream automation.
Agent Olympics: built a small evaluation runner that benchmarks a generalist agent vs discovered specialists across three task categories with explicit scoring criteria and summary reporting.
AI PEMDAS: built an instrumented coordination workflow where an evaluator routes sub-steps to ADD vs MULT agents and logs calls for end-to-end traceability (FastAPI JSON-RPC).

Built an evidence-driven resume generation pipeline that converts a master resume into canonical JSON, extracts candidate evidence, maps evidence to market-derived role signals, and assembles targeted resume variants through structured LLM workflows.

Implemented versioned artifacts, human review checkpoints, traceable evidence IDs, and DOCX/PDF rendering controls to separate source evidence, content selection, positioning, and presentation layout.
